## Final-Exam Study Sprint for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-14

A balanced 14-day plan with **3 hours on weekdays** and **6 hours on weekends**, built around **spaced repetition**, **mixed practice**, and **one full rest day**.
Each study block stays at **90 minutes or less**.

## Day-by-Day Revision Schedule

| Date | Day | Total Time | Priority Focus | Plan |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 2026-05-01 | Fri | 3h | Statistics | Block 1: 75m core formulas + key methods; Block 2: 75m worked problems; Block 3: 30m quick recall of formulas/errors |
| 2026-05-02 | Sat | 6h | Macroeconomics + Statistics | Block 1: 90m macro models; Block 2: 90m stats problem set; Block 3: 75m macro diagrams; Block 4: 75m stats correction review; Block 5: 30m flash review |
| 2026-05-03 | Sun | 6h | Organic Chemistry | Block 1: 90m reaction mechanisms; Block 2: 90m synthesis practice; Block 3: 75m nomenclature/stereochemistry; Block 4: 75m error log review; Block 5: 30m active recall |
| 2026-05-04 | Mon | 3h | Essay Writing | Block 1: 60m thesis + structure drills; Block 2: 75m timed paragraph practice; Block 3: 45m revise vocabulary, transitions, and common mistakes |
| 2026-05-05 | Tue | 3h | Statistics + Macroeconomics | Block 1: 75m statistics spaced review; Block 2: 75m macroecon recall + diagrams; Block 3: 30m mixed quiz on both subjects |
| 2026-05-06 | Wed | 3h | Organic Chemistry | Block 1: 75m reaction pathways; Block 2: 75m mechanism practice; Block 3: 30m flashcards for reagents and exceptions |
| 2026-05-07 | Thu | 3h | Essay Writing + Statistics | Block 1: 60m essay plan practice; Block 2: 75m statistics mixed problems; Block 3: 45m review weak spots from both |
| 2026-05-08 | Fri | 3h | Macroeconomics | Block 1: 75m key theories and graphs; Block 2: 75m short-answer practice; Block 3: 30m rapid recall of definitions |
| 2026-05-09 | Sat | 6h | Statistics + Organic Chemistry | Block 1: 90m statistics timed set; Block 2: 90m organic synthesis; Block 3: 75m stats error correction; Block 4: 75m organic flash review; Block 5: 30m mixed recall |
| 2026-05-10 | Sun | 6h | Macroeconomics + Essay Writing | Block 1: 90m macro timed essay/short answers; Block 2: 90m essay planning and intros; Block 3: 75m macro diagrams; Block 4: 75m essay body paragraph practice; Block 5: 30m recall quiz |
| 2026-05-11 | Mon | 3h | Full Mixed Review | Block 1: 75m statistics mixed questions; Block 2: 75m macro + organic recall; Block 3: 30m essay outline drill |
| 2026-05-12 | Tue | 3h | Organic Chemistry + Essay Writing | Block 1: 75m organic weak topics; Block 2: 60m essay timed response; Block 3: 45m review feedback and rewrite |
| 2026-05-13 | Wed | 3h | Light Consolidation | Block 1: 60m statistics formula sweep; Block 2: 60m macroeconomics diagram sweep; Block 3: 60m organic + essay final flash review |
| 2026-05-14 | Thu | 0h | Rest Day | Full rest: no studying; light walk, sleep, hydration, and exam-day prep only |

## Priority and Revision Strategy

- **Spaced repetition pattern:** each subject appears on Day 1, then returns after about 2–3 days, then again in a final consolidation phase.
- **High-priority subjects early:** statistics and organic chemistry get repeated problem/mechanism practice because they benefit most from active recall.
- **Macroeconomics rotation:** alternate between diagrams, definitions, and timed responses to strengthen both memory and exam writing.
- **Essay writing maintenance:** short, frequent drills on planning, intros, and body paragraphs to keep structure sharp without overloading.
- **Final 3-day taper:** reduce intensity, focus on weak areas, and use short recall blocks instead of long sessions.
- **Rest day protection:** keep 2026-05-14 study-free to preserve energy and reduce exam fatigue.
